messages:
Lina M: Quick thread to align on instructor kits + evaluation playbook for SI onboarding. We need a reproducible kit for mentors and a clear eval flow for certification.
Jordan K: Agree. Key constraints: 1) kit must survive cross-border shipping, 2) lowest-touch setup for mentors, 3) include a spare device + USB recovery image.
Priya S: Shipping note: customs paperwork delays for APAC could be 10+ business days. Recommend local loaner pools in SG and EU hubs.
Mark V: For mentor uptime we should define a kit check-in checklist (power, drivers, model weights verified). Proposal: a 6-step pre-session checklist.
Lina M: Draft checklist idea: unpack -> power cycle -> apply firmware update -> install drivers -> run smoke test -> run sample workload. Add expected runtimes.
Jordan K: Smoke test should be deterministic. Use a tiny model call and verify latency < 120ms and a basic token output match. We can publish a golden seed.
Priya S: About certification: propose two tiers: "Integrator" (operational) and "Advanced SI" (can customize runtime). Different badges and co-sell privileges.
Mark V: Evaluations: Integrator = written quiz + 1 practical (deploy + smoke test). Advanced = written + 2 practicals (latency tuning + quantization rollback scenario).
Lina M: Practical timing: 30-45m per scenario. Scoring rubric should be binary checkpoints with notes. Each scenario: must hit 7/10 checkboxes to pass.
Jordan K: Can we automate part of scoring? ops-bot can capture smoke test outputs and attach logs. Manual review only on edge failures.
ops-bot: created task #P-4932 to add smoke-test log collection to cert flow.
hw-partner-bot: Reminder: kit includes USB image v1.4.2, device serial range A1000-A1020, and quickstart cheat-sheet.
Priya S: Legal: we need a short partner addendum for loaner kit liability + data handling during certification sessions. Tagging LegalBot.
LegalBot: Noted. Will draft a short addendum template and circulate for partner review.
Mark V: Training content needs: instructor script, slide deck, 3 demo videos (provisioning, troubleshooting, rollback). Can we shoot short 6-8 minute vids?
Lina M: Yes. Also include a one-page rapid troubleshooting flowchart for mentors. Keep it printable.
Jordan K: Logistics Q: do mentors sign NDA to see firmware internals? If yes, add that step to onboarding.
Priya S: For pilot cohort, we'll exclude firmware internals; mentors can escalate to HW partner for deep-debug. NDA only if they request deep access.
Mark V: Timeline: draft curriculum + kit BOM by 2025-03-21, loaner pool confirmation by 2025-03-28, pilot cohort start 2025-04-14. Is that feasible?
Lina M: Sounds good. Need final sign-off from HW partner and Legal by 2025-03-25 to hit those dates.
Jordan K: Post-cert: propose a short co-branded "SI Ready" marketplace badge and a partner page with verified capabilities matrix. Marketing to prep a short case study after pilot.
Priya S: I'll coordinate with Marketing once pilot completes. Also want feedback form for mentors and participants after each cohort.
ops-bot: task P-4932 updated: assignees Lina M, Jordan K, Priya S, Mark V. Due 2025-03-25.
Lina M: Thanks everyone. I'll post the initial curriculum doc and BOM in #partnerships tomorrow. Keep this thread for blockers only.
